invariants.rationale: fontName is passed to skin.getFont(fontName), which is likely to require a non-null value.
If text is not null, calling text.length() is safe and its length is always non-negative.
If color is not null, it must be an instance of Color (which is always true by type).
fontName may be empty or non-empty; no restriction inferred except its required existence (covered by fontName != null).
If text is not null, its type must be a CharSequence, which is always true by type.
